radiusSource: Radius 0.2211 +/- 0.0069 solar radii from Xue et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of GJ 1132 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...973L...8X/abstract): 153,819 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.1945 +/- 0.0048 solar masses from Xue et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of GJ 1132 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...973L...8X/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3229 +/- 78 K from Xue et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of GJ 1132 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...973L...8X/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
